title: eavt
description: One EAVT row: a positive predication cell {e,a,v,t} asserting that entity e stands in attribute a to value v, witnessed by transaction t. Exactly these four fields and nothing else — negation/contradiction are read off the fold across rows, never a polarity field on the row itself. Identity is content: the RFC 6920 ni: URI of the row's RFC 8949 canonical CBOR encoding. SEAVT — EAVT where each e, a, and v is meant to be RMN — is a distinct, downstream lineage (witness-journal/semiotic custody), not this schema.
